participant_1.name: Michaela
participant_1.personality: Creative and nurturing, Michaela finds joy in her passions and values emotional connections.
participant_1.background: I've a dog. I'm scared of dying. Knitting is my passion. The county-wide bake sale is where I feel most at home. I love to bake cookies.
